coverage: 7 of 8 carriers verified against the carriers' own websites on 2026-09-01. Third-party sources were not used for any figure.

programs.refereeNote: Fizz's own pages conflict: the program page says $25 in every region, while the plan-page FAQ advertises $40 in a block tagged for Alberta, Ontario, BC and Manitoba. A real Ontario cart applied $40 on 2026-07-16.
programs.whenPaid: After the new member completes two months of service; the referrer is paid on their following payment
programs.planMinimum: $20/mo for the new member, before taxes and after discounts
programs.cap: None — "You can invite as many friends as you want"
programs.recoverable: No — "We cannot retroactively apply a referral code"

programs.accountType: Postpaid and prepaid — two separate programs, credits do not cross between them
programs.referee: $25 postpaid, paid as $5/month × 5 months. Prepaid: $5 on activation, then $5 per additional month the friend stays, up to 5 months
programs.referrer: The same as the new customer, in both programs
programs.whenPaid: Postpaid: within 4–8 weeks of the referral completing. Prepaid: first $5 within 24 hours, second after 30 days
programs.planMinimum: Postpaid: none stated. Prepaid: plans greater than $15
programs.cap: Postpaid $150/year (6 referrals). Prepaid up to $75/year, 3 referrals per 365 days
programs.recoverable: No — postpaid requires pre-registration; the prepaid code must be entered at activation
programs.note: Credits are tax-inclusive, so a $5 credit shows as about $4.42 in Ontario.

programs.referrer: 1 Public Point per 30 days that each referred line stays subscribed
programs.referrerNote: Public Mobile does not publish the cash value of a point on any current page. The commonly quoted "1 point = $1" traces to a staff forum post from January 2022.
programs.whenPaid: The $10 appears 4–8 weeks after activation, per Public Mobile's posted terms. Points accrue at the end of each 30-day cycle
programs.cap: None stated in the standing terms
programs.recoverable: No — the terms exclude past activations, though support has added forgotten codes by ticket

programs.referrer: $25 one-time service credit per successful referral
programs.whenPaid: Within 45 days of the referral completing, and the new account must first stay active 30 days. Postpaid: pre-tax bill adjustment. Prepaid: pre-tax top-up
programs.planMinimum: $25/mo with the Digital Discount applied — both parties
programs.cap: $250 per calendar year (10 referrals), including the $25 you received if you were referred in. 20 referrals lifetime
programs.recoverable: No — activating before claiming the offer voids both rewards
programs.note: There is no shareable code. The referrer sends an invite to a named person, who must claim it before activating. The terms permit referring only "individuals with whom you have a personal relationship". Your account also stops being eligible if you change your number or port away.
